dish.title: Galician Pulpo a la Gallega: Octopus and Potatoes with Smoked Paprika
dish.description: Tender cooked octopus tentacles warmed in the potato pot and sliced over coins of boiled Yukon Gold potatoes, dusted with sweet and hot smoked paprika and flaky salt and dressed with plenty of olive oil, served with blistered shishito peppers, garlic, and parsley.

recipe_version.title: Galician Pulpo a la Gallega: Octopus and Potatoes with Smoked Paprika
recipe_version.description: Tender cooked octopus tentacles warmed in the potato pot and sliced over coins of boiled Yukon Gold potatoes, dusted with sweet and hot smoked paprika and flaky salt and dressed with plenty of olive oil, served with blistered shishito peppers, garlic, and parsley.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: for the pot, plus a pinch for the peppers

ingredients.name: cooked octopus
ingredients.display_name: cooked octopus tentacles whose label lists octopus and salt

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp peppers, the rest to dress

ingredients.name: shishito peppers
ingredients.display_name: shishito peppers (standing in for padron peppers)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Peel the potatoes and slice them 1/2 inch thick. Thinly slice the garlic and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes, 10 cups water, and the salt in the covered 6-quart pot and bring to a boil over high, about 12 minutes to come to a boil. Simmer until just tender, about 10 minutes. Slip in the octopus for the last 3 minutes to heat through.

steps.title: Blister the peppers
steps.body: While the potatoes simmer (overlap stated): heat 1 tbsp oil in the 10-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Cook the shishitos, tossing, until blistered, about 5 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute. Season with a pinch of salt and the parsley.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Lift the potatoes onto the board or platter in an overlapping layer. Lift out the octopus, slice it into 1/2-inch coins, and scatter over the potatoes. Dust with both paprikas and the flaky salt and pour over the remaining olive oil. Serve with the peppers alongside.
